title: Design of Transit Networks: Global Optimization of Continuous Approximation Models via Geometric Programming
summary: Continuous approximation (CA) models have been widely adopted in transit network design studies due to their strong analytical tractability and high computational efficiency. However, such models are typically formulated as nonconvex optimization problems, and existing solution approaches mainly rely on iterative algorithms that exploit first-order optimality information or nonlinear programming solvers, whose solution quality lacks stability guarantees under complex demand conditions.
